d: After more than 13 years of anticipation, Rockstar Games has officially launched Grand Theft Auto VI worldwide on November 19, 2026, for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Built over eight years by more than 4,700 developers on an estimated $1.5 billion budget, the 212-gigabyte open-world title takes players to the Florida-inspired state of Leonida, following criminal duo Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval.
